evidence_boundary: The archived results establish only the properties encoded in the five symbolic models and the generated property-based tests. They do not independently establish operating-system security, hardware safety, memory safety, termination, external-specification correctness, or requirements that were not formalised. Runtime measurements are execution-specific observations rather than formal performance guarantees.
